examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parivīmaṃsamāno parivīmaṃsati, yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ, idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ?
etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.
kittāvatā nu kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhū parivīmaṃsamāno parivīmaṃseyya sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti?

44303.meaning1: engages in a thorough investigation; gives a complete examination

examples.text: so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati.

44304.meaning1: engaging in a thorough investigation; giving a complete examination

examples.text: tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicarato parivīmaṃsam'āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ
so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati.
yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicayati parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjati, dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti

44308.meaning1: who has served probation; undegone a trial period
44308.commentary: (PYt) parivasiyitthā'ti parivuttho, parivuttho parivāso etassā'ti parivutthaparivāso, tassa.

examples.text: yo kho, kassapa, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. api ca mayā puggalavemattatā viditā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

44310.commentary: (KVt) parivutthaparivāsenā'ti ādimhi parivutthaparivāseneva parivāsato uttari itivārena ādito bhikkhunāva chārattaṃ, parivattitaliṅgena uddham'pi bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, na parivāse viya tappaccayā aciṇṇamānatto. ciṇṇamānatto'va abbhetabbo, na itaro, na parivāse viya mānattārahe, pakkhamānattañ'ca carantiyā bhikkhuniyā liṅgaṃ parivattātikkame sati ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu hoti, puna bhikkhumānattaṃ gahetvā ciṇṇamānatto'va bhikkhu abbhetabbo'ti dasseti.

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.

44312.meaning2: separated residence of monks (now it means a place for religious learning)

examples.text: kammasamayo nāma antamaso pariveṇam'pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

44313.meaning1: monastery grounds; space around a building
44313.meaning2: surroundings of a building, surrounding walk
44313.commentary: (VINa) pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā'ti sace pāto asammaṭṭhaṃ sammaṭṭham'pi vā puna tiṇapaṇṇ'ādīhi uklāpaṃ pādappahārehi ca vikiṇṇavālikaṃ jātaṃ, sammajjitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tena sammatena bhikkhunā pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññapetvā dutiyaṃ gahetvā nisīditabbaṃ.

44314.meaningLit: for the sake of a monastery

44318.commentary: (SNPa) parivesanā vattatī'ti tesaṃ suvaṇṇabhājan'ādīni gahetvā nisinnānaṃ pañcasatānaṃ kassakānaṃ parivisanā vippakatā hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanā vattati. atha kho bhagavā yena parivesanā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

44319.meaning2: kept up, protected, carried about, avoided

44320.commentary: (VINa) sukhaparihato'ti sukhena parihato, jātakālato pabhuti dhātīhi aṅkato aṅkaṃ haritvā dhāriyamāno assakarathak'ādīhi bālakīḷanakehi kīḷamāno sādurasabhojanaṃ bhojiyamāno sukhena parihato.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa mātāpitaro raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ, tvaṃ kho'si, tāta raṭṭhapāla, amhākaṃ ekaputtako piyo manāpo sukh'edhito sukhaparihato.
mañcakena ce'pi maṃ, sāriputta, pariharissatha, n'ev'atthi tathāgatassa paññāveyyattiyassa aññathattaṃ.
mañ'hi, bhante, aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ nāḷandaṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ, upāli amhākaṃ gahapati sāvakattaṃ upagato'ti.
yāvatā candimasūriyā, pariharanti disā bhanti virocanā. tāva sahassadhā loko, ettha te vattate vaso.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, candimasūriyā pariharanti disā bhanti virocamānā, tāva sahassadhā loko.
so attānaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, att'ādhipateyyaṃ.
dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.
theyyasattho nāma corā katakammā vā honti akatakammā vā, rājānaṃ vā theyyaṃ gacchanti suṅkaṃ vā pariharanti.
yo hi, gahapati, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttam'pi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya, kim'aññatra bālyā?
cel'aṇḍukena ce'pi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya, labheyyuṃ payirūpāsanāya, tesam'pi lābhā tesam'pi suladdhaṃ

44330.meaning2: kept up, protected, carried about, avoided

44331.meaning2: kept up, protected, carried about, avoided

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, ayaṃ te, ambho purisa, samatittiko telapatto antarena ca mahāsamajjaṃ antarena ca janapadakalyāṇiyā pariharitabbo.

44333.meaning2: should be kept up, should be protected, should be avoided

44334.meaning1: to take care (of); to look after; to maintain

examples.text: ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātiṃ kātuṃ. katamehi ekādasahi?

44335.meaning1: having carried a child in the womb; having been pregnant

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na h'evaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. das'eva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati. ayam'ettha dhammatā.

44336.meaning2: having kept up, having protected, having carried about, having avoided

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo. svāssudaṃ aṅken'eva aṅkaṃ parihariyati

44341.meaning2: having laughed at, having mocked, having derided

examples.text: appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike.
catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo parihānāya nibbānass'eva santike

44344.meaning1: of a nature to decline; able to regress; liable to deteriorate

examples.text: imassa kho puggalassa akusalā dhammā antarahitā, kusalā dhammā sammukhībhūtā. atthi ca khv'assa akusalamūlaṃ asamucchinnaṃ, tamhā tassa akusalā akusalaṃ pātubhavissati. evam'ayaṃ puggalo āyatiṃ parihānadhammo bhavissatī'ti.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, parihānadhammo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā.
appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ bhogaparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.
tato tuyhaṃ, bhikkhu, yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihānī'ti.

44352.meaning1: causing loss; causing decline; detrimental; ruinous

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo parihāniyā dhammā? saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, dovacassatā, pāpamittatā, ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo parihāniyā dhammā.

44354.meaning1: matter which causes decline; something which causes deterioration; detrimental quality

examples.text: imasmiṃ sutte parihāniyadhammā'va kathitā. dutiye aparihāniyadhammā lok'uttaramissakā kathitā.

44356.meaning2: caused to dwindle, brought ruin, neglected, omitted

44357.meaning2: lets fall away; loses; wastes; lit. causes to decrease
44357.commentary: (SNa) parihāpetī'ti hāpeti na pāpuṇāti. kusītapuggalassa hi cha dvārāni aguttāni honti, tīṇi kammāni aparisuddhāni, ājīvaṭṭhamakaṃ sīlaṃ apariyodātaṃ, bhinnājīvo kul'ūpako hoti. so sabrahmacārīnaṃ akkhimhi patitarajaṃ viya upaghātakaro hutvā dukkhaṃ viharati, pīṭhamaddano c'eva hoti laṇḍapūrako ca, satthu ajjhāsayaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, dullabhaṃ khaṇaṃ virādheti, tena bhutto raṭṭhapiṇḍo'pi na mahapphalo hoti.

examples.text: dukkhaṃ, bhikkhave, kusīto viharati vokiṇṇo pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi, mahantañ'ca sadatthaṃ parihāpeti.

44358.meaning2: having caused to dwindle, having brought ruin, having neglected, having omitted

44359.meaning2: caused to dwindle, brought ruin, neglected, omitted

44360.commentary: (NIDD1) te kāmā parihāyantī'ti te vā kāmā parihāyanti, so vā kāmehi parihāyati.

examples.text: tassa ce kāmayānassa, chandajātassa jantuno, te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.
yañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, diṭṭhaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na bhāsitabban'ti vadāmi.
dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.
so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

44362.commentary: (NIDD1) te kāmā parihāyantī'ti te vā kāmā parihāyanti, so vā kāmehi parihāyati.

examples.text: dhammikā kho asurā, adhammikā devā, tatth'eva dān'āhaṃ asurapuraṃ gamissāmī'ti, atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi baddhaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi parihāyati.
tassa ce kāmayānassa, chandajātassa jantuno, te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.

pañcadvārikā pavatte pañcadvāravasena pavattamānā paṭhamavaye vīsativassakāle rajjanadussanamuyhanavasena adhimattā balavatī hoti, paṇṇāsavassakāle ṭhitā hoti, saṭṭhivassakālato paṭṭhāya parihāyamānā asītinavutivassakāle mandā hoti.

44364.meaning1: fell short; fell away; wasted away

examples.text: mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye
sace mayaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pasayha pasayha kāraṇaṃ karissāma, mā yam'pi'ssa taṃ saddhāmattakaṃ pemamattakaṃ tamhā'pi parihāyī'ti.
tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi.

44366.meaning2: having dwindled, having wasted away, having fallen away from

examples.text: daharo kira ākāsena gacchanto girigāmavāsikammāradhītāya pañcahi kumārīhi saddhiṃ padumasaraṃ gantvā nhatvā padumāni ca pilandhitvā madhurassarena gāyantiyā saddaṃ sutvā kāmarāgena viddho visesā parihāyitvā anayabyasanaṃ pāpuṇi.

pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

ime'pi rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā, yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.
so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena so yena yen'eva pakkamati samādāy'eva pakkamati

44375.commentary: (SNa) ahārī aparihārī'ti udakaṃ na harati na pariharati, na pariyādiyatī'ti attho. (SNt) bahi vissandanavasena udakaṃ na haratī'ti ahārī, parito na paggharatī'ti aparihārī.

examples.text: asu, bhante, puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo, yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā, yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā, yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya'pi, no'pi nikkhipeyya.
atha kho, bhaggava, acelo kaḷāramaṭṭako nacirass'eva parihito sānucāriko vicaranto odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān'eva vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nihīno kālam'akāsi.
yam'assa vādaṃ parihīnam'āhu, apāhataṃ pañhavimaṃsakāse, paridevati socati hīnavādo, upaccagā man'ti anutthunāti.
amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, parihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati parihīnā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, aparihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparihīnā'ti.
sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva vīvadātā, saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā, na tesaṃ koci parihīnapañño, diṭṭhī hi tesam'pi tathā samattā.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno, seyyathā'pi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi. balavīriye parihīne tam'eva nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ nevāpikassa paccāgamiṃsu.

44382.commentary: (SNa) gihibhogā ca parihīno'ti yo agāre vasantehi gihīhi dāyajje bhājiyamāne bhogo laddhabbo assa, tato ca parihīno.

examples.text: gihibhogā parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca dubbhago, paridhaṃsamāno pakireti, chav'ālātaṃ'va nassati.

44384.meaning1: of inferior intelligence; of low intellect; lacking in wisdom

examples.text: sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva vīvadātā, saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā, na tesaṃ koci parihīnapañño, diṭṭhī hi tesam'pi tathā samattā.

44385.meaning1: whose material gain and honour had declined

examples.text: gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.
tassa kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato kāy'ārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattaṃ bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati
yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

so aparena samayena rūpānaṃ'y'eva samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo

44389.commentary: (PMa) pariḷāhanānattan'ti chandanānattatāya rūpapariḷāho saddapariḷāho'ti evaṃ pariḷāhanānattaṃ uppajjati.

examples.text: saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ, chandanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariḷāhanānattaṃ, pariḷāhanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariyesanānānattaṃ, pariyesanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati lābhanānattaṃ. ime nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.

44390.meaning1: due to burning passion; because of sexual fever

examples.text: tesaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyataṃ sārāgo udapādi, pariḷāho kāyasmiṃ okkami. te pariḷāhapaccayā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsu.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo

44393.meaning1: action of another person; effort of another; attack by someone

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso, yaṃ par'ūpakkamena tathāgataṃ jīvitā voropeyya. anupakkamena, bhikkhave, tathāgatā parinibbāyanti.

44395.meaning1: who harms others; who injures others
44395.commentary: (DNa) par'ūpaghātī'ti etassa paraṃ viheṭhayanto'ti vevacanaṃ. atha vā par'ūpaghātī'ti sīl'ūpaghātī. sīlañhi uttam'aṭṭhena paran'ti vuccati. yo ca samaṇo paraṃ yaṃ kañci sattaṃ viheṭhayanto par'ūpaghātī hoti, attano sīlaṃ vināsako, so pabbajito nāma na hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā, na hi pabbajito par'ūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.

44396.meaning2: censuring by others, reproach of others

examples.text: yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ, par'ūpavādā na karonti pāpaṃ, bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan'ti.

44397.meaning1: criticism of others; blaming other people

examples.text: ekam'idaṃ, bho gotama, samayaṃ todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa parisati par'ūpārambhaṃ vattenti, bālo ayaṃ rājā eḷeyyo samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasanno, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karoti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.
tena kho pana samayena satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca acelakā satta ca ekasāṭakā satta ca paribbājakā parūḷhakacchanakhalomā khārivividham'ādāya bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.

44399.meaning1: with long armpit hair, nails and body hair
44399.commentary: (SNa) parūḷhakacchanakhalomā'ti parūḷhakacchā parūḷhanakhā parūḷhalomā, kacch'ādīsu dīghalomā dīghanakhā cā'ti attho.
